q: Destruction be for every person who searches for faults
v.s: Woe to every scorner and mocker

q: (because of his extreme love for wealth)
amasses wealth and keeps meticulous count of it
(not spending any of it for Allaah's' 'pleasure).
v.s: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
v.c: who amasses wealth ˹greedily˺ and counts it ˹repeatedly˺,

q: thinks that his wealth will keep him alive forever
v.s: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
v.c: thinking that their wealth will make them immortal!

q: (This will never be so! He will soon have to die and then)
He will certainly be thrown into the “Thresher”
v.s: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
v.c: Not at all! Such a person will certainly be tossed into the Crusher.

q: How will you know what the “Thresher”
v.s: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
v.c: And what will make you realize what the Crusher is?

v.s: It is the fire of God, [eternally] fueled,
Which mounts directed at the hearts.

q: It will certainly be locked over them
v.s: Indeed, it [i.e., Hellfire] will be closed down upon them
v.c: It will be sealed over them,

q: (The flames of Jahannam will rise high above the people like massive pillars, from which they will never be able to escape.)
